column14: A fast-paced daily word challenge. 18 words, 30 seconds each to unscramble them. Can you get them all in time?
A fun twist on the popular Connections game. Four categories. Three words each. One word is in all four.

An adversarial game inspired by Wordle. This puzzle will actively change the secret word in the background, while still conforming to your guesses. Absurdle's goal is to make the game as long as possible. Are you up for the challenge?
Three clues point to one connecting word. Reveal more clues when you need them, and score more for solving early.
Slide all 7 letters around a board with walls and line them up to find the day's 6 hidden words.
Anagardens is a daily word puzzle where each answer is an anagram of the previous answer’s letters, plus one hidden letter.
Unscramble the letters to find the hidden word. 5 rounds each day.
The ultimate word puzzle game combining Wordle's gameplay with Scrabble scoring.
Try to guess a hidden singular noun. When a guess is wrong, the game reveals something the guessed noun has in common with the answer, so each miss becomes a clue!
The creator of this game is challenging the world to beat her at Boggle, the classic word finding game. Are you up for the challenge?
Daily spelling bee game with five progressively harder words and audio-only hints. Spell one word wrong and your day is done.
Guess the secret word hidden between other words.
Wordle meets Tetris - Blockle is a unique blend of a word and puzzle game with a new challenge every day.
Create as many words as you can using the 7 letters in the blossom. All words must use the center letter.

Each day you get a first and a last letter, and you hunt for words that start and end with them - the longest word, the shortest word, and answers in three bonus categories such as dog breeds, cheeses and countries.
Daily romantasy word game. It's Wordle for romance fantasy readers. Every word is romantasy-coded, and solving it reveals which book inspired the word, plus similar reads.
Word puzzle where each of the 5 clues on the left side of the river have one clue on the right side they match with.  Move clues up/down until they align, then type the word that bridges them.
A daily word game that challenges you to find popular and esoteric 5-letter words by connecting tiles.
Use clues to uncover overlapping words hidden in a layered jumble of letters. Solve it as quickly as possible, track your mistakes and hints used, and compare your time on the daily leaderboard.

Solve a chain of 5 words, progressing from 3 to 7 letters. Each level is like its own Wordle. Solve each level to unlock the next one. Previous guesses become clues to the next word you are trying to guess.
Find the 8 words to solve the case (beware the red herrings!)
3 categories to find and one word that is in all of them.
The objective of Chain Link is to identify all the words in the CHAIN - One letter at a time. Every word on the chain LINKS logically, with the word below it
Find the word in the middle, using the meaning of the surrounding words. For example, pizza and pasta are linked by tomato.
Turn the start word into the end word, changing/adding/removing one letter per step. Match par to earn a star.

Daily puzzle where you guess one hidden word from three escalating clues - a word, then an emoji, then an image - in three tries. Each wrong guess unlocks the next clue. The twist is that every day the puzzle runs on a different "mechanic" that changes how the clues relate to the answer.
A free daily word puzzle game. Find four groups of four words that share a hidden connection. New puzzle every day, 370+ puzzle archive, custom puzzle creator, and multiplayer race mode.
Play ClueDay, a free daily word puzzle game. Get 5 clues to guess the mystery word, with Wordle-style letter hints.
Guess any word, and it will be scored based on how similar it is to the target word. Try to narrow your way towards the target word in as few guesses as possible!

Word-pair chain game. Each clue asks you to find the word that naturally pairs with it, then your answer becomes the next clue. Solve five connected pairs, follow the chain, and enjoy that little snap of recognition with every link.
Guess the word using as few hints as possible. Each guess reveals a new clue, or Cluno.
A word game where every puzzle comes with a cryptic clue, so it's deduction, not just guessing. It has Easy/Medium/Hard days, and a full playable archive.
Think of two words that use up all of the day's letters. A simple, but unique game with a fun theme!

Coil is a word-chain puzzle where every turn gets harder. Start with a seed word and build a chain, one word at a time. Each new word must share more letters with the previous one than the last: 1 shared letter, then 2, then 3, and so on. Reach a 6-word chain to beat the puzzle.
Rank 5 everyday English words from most to least used, in 3 tries.
A constellation word puzzle game. Fill all the words in the network to complete the puzzle!
CrissWord is essentially a 2-clue mini crossword where there are multiple common letters in the answers.
Solve a list of words which are connected by simple transformations. The first and last words always have the same clue.
Like a crossword but all words are across & letters in each column always match.
Place nine given words on a 3×3 grid so each matches its row and column, then check the whole grid. Words can have several meanings, but only one complete arrangement works.
CrossEights is a quick, scored, and clueless crossword: fill a grid with eight intersecting 8-letter words, 4 reading across, 4 reading down.
A crossword game where each tile on the board can be flipped. Flip tiles to reveal the correct letters and create words relating to the daily theme.
Arrange words on a grid, crossing matching letters like a crossword. Pack them into the smallest possible rectangle and see if you can match the perfect score!
Sixteen letters are on the board. Swap them until all four answers read correctly.
Similar to Wordle, but there are two target words which intersect to form a tiny crossword. Orange tiles indicate a correctly guessed letter in the wrong word.
Everyone gets the same 21 letters, builds one connected crossword, and sees how their score ranks against every player!

Each day features a hidden quote or saying from a famous person or historical figure. Piece together the quote by finding the correct missing letters. Use pattern matching, logic, and your knowledge to solve the cryptographic puzzle!
Unlock the hidden 6-letter word in 5 tries!
7 encrypted words. A handful of guesses. Can you solve the Cyphr?

Create five words, each with a starting letter, to get your best score. Every day we strategically pick five letters that must be used, (one for each word) and shuffle the point values for the alphabet. Everyone gets the same given letters and point values.
Solve a series of analogy puzzles in the form of ___ is to ___ as ___ is to ___. You are given a list of words to form the solution.
A timed solo bananagrams-style puzzle with a new Easy and Hard puzzle every day. Complete the word crossword using the all tiles on your rack!
Each tile has two words, and tiles are connected when their active words are synonyms. Switch between words to break every connection in as few moves as possible.
Like Wordle, but your objective is to NOT guess the hidden word, while still conforming to the colored hints.
A daily word puzzle where you get four phone-keypad digits and build as many words as you can from their letters.
Similar to Wordle, except you solve two puzzles at once! Every guess reveals letters from each puzzle.
A daily crossword with a twist: every clue has two answers. The clue won’t tell you which answer goes where, that's the puzzle.
A daily word puzzle where one answer fits two clues. Find the word or phrase that bridges both meanings in 5 tries.
A daily word puzzle about phrases, not letters. Ten words, each finishing a common two-word phrase with the one above; type the next word, take a hint when you're stuck, share the shape of your fall.
Solve clues and release words so their letters cascade into matching spaces below. Fill the missing letters to complete ten words in each of three new daily puzzles.
Draw pixel art with 5-letter words. Each row of the daily drawing is a Wordle pattern. Find words that color in the picture according to Wordle color feedback!
Spell words (3+ letters) with the falling tiles. Play bonus squares to score big. Can you beat the clock?
Daily word association game with 3 rounds of increasing difficulty. Find the ducks, avoid the goose. HONK
Guess 32 words at the same time! Solve in 37 guesses or less to win, but you can keep playing until you guess all the words.

Elided is a daily word puzzle where players have up to four guesses to find the single longest word in a string of 16 letters. Words are spelled left-to-right, skipping letters as needed. Incorrect guesses mark each used tile to reveal whether it belongs in the solution.
A word game with a world: 50 kingdoms, 3,200 puzzles, words that fight back.

You have 6 attempts to guess a 5 letter word. Letters are pixelated. When you guess a word, it reveals the pixels of the correct letter for that box by showing the common pixels between your guess and the correct letter.
A daily etymology puzzle. Nine words, three hidden word families, three impostors. Find the connections by shared root.
Work with other players worldwide to solve a giant grid of Wordle-like puzzles!
Discover the secret multi-word expression with Wordle-style hints
Break ice and fruit cubes to recover letters, then use across and down clues to complete a crossword.
Almost exactly like Wordle, but with a twist: there's one lie in every row! The lies are in the same positions for everyone. Good luck!
Trace hidden words across a 4×4 grid (or a themed 5×5) to clear it before your fuel runs out. Scored 1–5 stars on efficiency, with a 1v1 race mode, Speed Streak mode, and a full puzzle archive.
Daily word game combining Wordle-style clues with Flappy Bird-inspired controls. Land letters and solve the five-letter word.
7 forbidden letters - make words from the rest, score points, climb the ranks, find the daily grail word and earn streaks and badges. Two modes every day - Quick and Classic
A daily foundry of four fun word puzzles (anagram-decay, portmanteaus, common-bond links, column-shift grid). Play all four to complete the day!
Fourbe is a free daily word puzzle where four challenging clues each point to a single hidden answer. Solve all four rounds, then guess the subject that connects them all.
You get 5 cards, each with 4 words on them. Rotate and place them to match the categories along the edges. Can you match them all?
Reveal the word or words by guessing letters, one at a time. Get a letter wrong, and a new word is added. Get eight letters wrong, and it's game over.
A daily word puzzle where letters stack into visual glyphs. Study the overlapping shapes, and decode the hidden word! A unique and challenging game.
A daily crossword with no clues: every letter corresponds to a number from 1 to 26. Crack the code from two or three givens.
A daily word game with golf-style scoring. Compete against other players on the live tournament leaderboard.

Griddle is a daily 3x3 word puzzle. You're given 9 unique letters in a grid, and you find the one 9-letter word that uses every cell, with the rule that consecutive letters can't be orthogonally adjacent.
Find as many words as you can from a 3×3 letter grid. Words don't have to be touching. See how you stack up against ohter players.
A daily crossword that you solve by logic instead of clues, using available letters to spell the word in each slot. Daily games getting harder as the week goes.
A new real news headline appears every day with one word blanked out. Guess the missing word using hotter/colder feedback and hints if you need them.
Decipher the encoded alphabet for a list of items in a given category. Every day a new category and cipher is released. Everyone gets the same category, cipher and hint order.

Handful is a free daily word game. Everyone gets the same seven lettered tiles. Make your three best words: tiles carry letter values, longer words earn a length bonus, and using all seven scores +15.
A turn-based word game on a hex grid where you can swap tiles OR make a word, and every turn adds more letters. Make words to clear space and last as long as you can!
Find words on a hexagonal grid, without crossing walls.
Find kangaroo words: real English words that hide their own synonym, spelled in order, inside themselves. For example, BLOSSOM hides BLOOM.
Five categories, 30 seconds each. Every answer is a fish, and the rarer the answer, the heavier the catch.
Wordle meets Mastermind. Daily challenges and pvp modes.
A daily puzzle game where you decode fun emoji combinations to guess popular idioms and phrases. Test your creativity and language skills with new emoji puzzles every day.
Spell words with tiles to build a bonus, then spell the hidden word to win it!
Figure out the word of the day by honing in on each letter. Instead of a simple "right or wrong," you get a "higher or lower," and must deduce from there!
"I Would Like to Solve". Solve the partly-spelled phrase. Finish it correctly, or make it funnier!
A word-scoring puzzle with no hidden answer. Spell any word of 3 to 8 letters to score the most points under the day's letter values, bonus slots and three rules.
A daily 5x5 Waffle-style word grid: swap scrambled tiles into six interlocking five-letter words in 15 swaps or fewer, tiles recoloring after each move.
A daily cryptic word game, styled as a grey and white case file. The answer is hidden in the wordplay.

Lasso the jumbled words. Each day's hex board is split into hidden groups of touching letters, and every group is an anagram of a word, so its letters won't always be in order. Drag a loop around cells or tap them to find all words. Wrong guesses earn hints.
Every daily puzzle begins with four mini-games: LetterLock, Anagram, Crossword, and Word Search. Solve each one to unlock a word for the Final Board.
Like Wordle, but with a twist that the secret word can have up to 10 letters. After each guess, the color and shape of the tiles change to help you find the secret word.

Letter Flick is a daily word physics puzzle. The day's word is scattered on the board with an extra letter. Players must flick the letters of the word off the grid while following the tile movement puzzle rules.
Choose any word from the category, and sacrifice a letter each time. Can you survive to the end?

Like a Word Search only in reverse. Use available letters by stacking them from the bottom up in 3x3 or 4x4 grids to form words in rows, cols, or even diagonal. Difficulty increases throughout the week.
Find the quote to escape the maze! A fun and unique combination of a word game and maze!
Letterkin is a daily word puzzle where you solve five clues using as few different letters as possible. Play, beat the target, and share your score online.
One random letter, ten categories, ninety seconds. Everyone gets the same board each day, and you score more for answers nobody else thought of.
Guess the secret word. After each guess, you'll see how many letter edits (add, remove, or replace) it takes to match the answer. Refine your guesses and reach 0 to win.
A daily phrase puzzle game. Find 4 famous phrases hidden in a grid of words.

There are enough word games out there to teach you how to spell. Linxicon is a game that teaches you what words mean! Your goal is to connect two random words by creating a chain of new words that bridge the gap in their meanings.
Rephrase a twelve-word sentence in exactly five words, using only its words.
Words that look alike in two languages but mean different things. Can you spot the trap?
Daily word-grouping puzzle: sort 16 words into 4 groups, with 4 shared link tiles that chain them into a loop.
The Weight of Words - spell physical nouns that would destroy the target noun shown. Interactions with the target noun are generated dynamically based on what you spell with the provided letters.
Find the three two-letter pairs hidden in twelve fragments. Each pair completes four everyday words — the letters can land at the start, middle, or end.
Crosswords meet nonograms. Use the scrambled letter clues to deduce the words in every row and column.
A word-bridge puzzle. Find the missing middle word that completes a compound word or phrase on both sides.
The "Midi" crossword is bigger than a mini, smaller than a full grid. 7x7 Monday through Thursday, 8x8 Friday and Saturday, and a 9x9 finale on Sunday. Timed, with Check and Reveal.
A daily 5x5 crossword you solve against the clock, with classic crossword-style clues.
Solve the word riddle by looking for hidden meanings! Break down a phrase to deduce the hidden word. A challenging, but addicting game. Hints are available if you need them!
Find the one word that fits every category.
Change one letter at a time to morph the start word into the target — in as few moves as you can. A daily word puzzle with a whole suite of modes.
Morse code based game inspired by Wordle. Listen to the morse code, and see if you can guess the secret word!
Challenge yourself with No Spell Check, the daily spelling game with no hints or autocorrect. Test your vocabulary with words from easy to expert level. New words every day!

Change one letter of a word, one step at a time, over four steps. There are four different types of adaptations to choose from, each of which must be used once to win the game. There's no specific string of words to aim for, find your own path to win!

A word-and-trivia puzzle. Each puzzle is a phrase that contains a number. You start with the number, then guess missing letters to uncover the mystery phrase. The fewer guesses you use, the higher you score.
A word has been omitted from several sentences. Your job is to figure out which word fits all of them.
You are given Wordle-style clues that have only ONE possible answer, you have one shot to get it. You can ask for more clues, but it lowers your score.
A daily word game where rare beats obvious. Find the words everyone else misses on a new 5×5 grid each day, and climb the Outlier worldwide leaderboard!
Similar to Wordle in many ways, but uses three letters pairs to make 6 letter words.  Surprisingly harder than it looks or super easy at other times.
Find three pangrams daily as quickly as possible. Letters can be reused, and each pangram involves a different set of letters.
Guess 5 English words every day by listening to translations in 12 other languages. Each language can only be used once across all 5 words. The less language hints you use, the higher your score.
A tricky wordplay game. Transform phrases through wordplay to solve cryptic crossword puzzles.
Guess the encoded phrase in this raisin-powered daily word game. Earn raisins for solving, unlock bonus riddles, and work your way toward grapeness.

PIVOT is a free daily word puzzle. Each day, a 3×6 grid appears with a hidden 4-letter word in the gold center row. Tap pivot dots between letters to rotate them 90°. Solve in as few moves as possible. New puzzle every day, same for everyone.
Guess the words using color pixel clues!
Word ladder game that challenges you to transform a four-letter word into the word "POOP" by changing just one letter at a time.
Every day get an image representing a pun, three guesses to solve it, and hints if you get stuck.
Find words based on two-word hints.
Pyramid is a daily word jumble where only one vowel solves every row, from 3-letter to 7-letter words.
Daily word puzzle inspired by Apple News+ Quartiles. Players combine 2-4 letter fragment tiles to form words, scoring more points the more tiles they use.
Complete the well-known quote from the word bank! Get color-coded hints after each round.
You hop between words choosing rhymes, synonyms or antonyms in a chain to get from start to finish in as few hops as possible.

Every game of Raddle is in the form of a ladder. You're shown the first and last word. To fill in the rungs, you have to transform the previous word a new word or phrase, by applying one of the clues.
A daily sliding word puzzle where you choose a 4x4 or 5x5 board and arrange each row into a themed word based on the daily category.
The news, decoded. A free daily rebus puzzle drawn from today's news. Crack the visual, name the phrase, then read the coverage.
A Wikipedia article has been redacted. Guess words to reveal them. Find the title to win.
Place and slide phrases across a grid so the red letters form hidden words vertically.
Wordle is getting too easy for you? Try the reverse. You are given a pattern and the solution word. You have to guess the rest of the words.

A daily word-and-logic puzzle where you solve the missing words and connect their letters through a grid. The shade of each tile tells you how far the next letter must be, and the words join into one continuous route using every tile once.
A daily word puzzle where you rebuild five scrambled rows by swapping letters.
Rung is a free daily word game of nerve. One everyday answer, five clues from cryptic to obvious, worth 5 down to 1 points. Guess early to score big, a wrong guess burns two rungs.

Rushle gives you 26 target words, one for every letter of the alphabet. Type any 5-letter word and matching letters cascade across the entire board, chain-reaction style. Race to clear all 26 rows as fast as you can!
Rearrange the pool of letter tiles you're given to make the day's hidden five-letter words. Two levels: CHILL and CHALLENGE.
A "Wordle meets Scrabble" daily word game where you have to complete as many 4 letter words as you can with your given tiles.
Unscramble a famous quote by swapping letters on the board. Quotes come from movies, sports, shows, and historical figures.
It's like wordle, but you solve 16 Wordle-inspired games at once! You get 21 guesses to solve all the puzzles. A unique sedecordle every day and unlimited free puzzles!
Race against the clock to spell ten scrambled words as fast as you can. Every day a new set of words are released. Everyone gets the same words, in the same order, in the same shuffled configuration.
Shrinkle is a daily word reduction game. Click letters to shrink words into new valid words until you find the hidden phrase.
Daily 5x5 word puzzle: slide whole rows and columns until all five rows spell words. Tiles wrap around the edges. Timed score, clue-bar hints, Easy and Hard modes.
Slide tiles on a word-tile board to spell the hidden words
Use 9 letters to make words, and try to solve the daily Pangram.
Guess the word in seven tries — Wordle rules, except you don't know how long it is.
A word puzzle that plays like a logic puzzle. Five words with letters missing, and exactly enough tiles to fill them. Most rows can be finished several ways. Only one set uses every tile.
A daily word game in two dimensions! The game board is a square which contains 5 horizontal and 5 vertical words. Guess correctly to turn the whole board green!
Solve 4 Wordle puzzles in a row, each word one letter longer than the last. You have 20 total guesses.
Five words, one pyramid. You’re given all 15 letters—arrange them to form five interlocking words.

Like Wordle, but all the hints are given in symbols. The hints correspond to the same hints as in Wordle, e.g. right letter wrong place, right letter right place, and wrong letter. The extra challenge is figuring out what each symbol means.

Each day there is a new small crossword built from three interlocking words that are all synonyms of each other. Reveal letters Wordle-style, use the synonym link to deduce whole words,  and clear as many of the day's 20 puzzles as you can before your hearts run out.
Swap tiles on a 4×4 grid until every row spells a word, and every column too. Get hints along the way.

A word hunt game that challenges players to extract as many words as they can from a unique, hive themed board. Arranged in changing honeycomb patterns, the grid creates a visual labyrinth where words are hidden in plain sight.

Bite-sized cryptic puzzle. Solve it on your own or use progressive hints, then see how the wordplay works. Designed for experienced cryptic fans and curious beginners alike, it wraps the daily puzzle in a distinctive vintage newspaper experience.
Decode a leaked story in this daily word puzzle: fill ten redacted words using letter clues, optional Scan and UV tools, then compare your newsroom score.
Solve word puzzles by dropping down letters to solve headlines for a fantasy newspaper, unraveling a developing story every day!
Five quick daily puzzles in a tiny online newspaper: a missing-word headline, a word ladder, a code to crack, a letter box and a little logic mystery.
A Daily Mini Crossword Word Game! Guess the three intersecting words, with Wordle-style hints!
Add words to the grid, with matching adjacent letters becoming removable. Clear the whole grid to win!
Like a crossword, but you need to rotate/re-arrange the tiles to create it and match the clues.
A daily tiled words puzzle where you rotate and move tiles to complete the themed words in the board. A new puzzle every day.
Arrange the letter tiles in the grid and guess the words from the clue. The Daily Tird is three little puzzles a day, easy, medium and hard, with free letters if you get stuck, plus an endless mode.

Toadle is Wordle's calmer cousin. Four-letter word, ten tries, and the feedback is one number per guess: a score you have to unpack. No green, no yellow, just the total of two points per letter in place plus one point per letter in the word.

Find the middle word that bridges a left word and a right word into two real compound words (e.g. BACK → GROUND → WATER: BACKGROUND, GROUNDWATER). Three puzzles a day at increasing difficulty, plus a lifeline assist if you get stuck.
Organize the letter tiles into words on a grid. Everyone plays the same fourteen letters, and the highest scoring board wins the day.
Each box has a hint word that contains the secret letter for that spot. Guess a word that uses one letter from each box, in order. Each wrong guess costs 10 seconds.

Vendy is a daily word puzzle where you uncover the connection between two hidden words using color-coded clues. It’s quick to learn, satisfying to solve, and offers new puzzles every day—plus the ability to create and share your own.
A daily word puzzle game created by an education consultant. Categorize similar words into three sections of a Venn diagram, and then solve by guessing the one word that connects them all!
A fun, gamified, time bound word game to learn new words and expand your vocabulary
Six words, one hidden word that connects them all. Use the cryptic clues to complete the grid.
Fill in the missing vowels to reveal the hidden word.
Build a chain of words from a starting word to a target. Each new word must be one letter different from a word already in your graph — by adding, removing, or changing a single letter.
New daily word game where words expand and collapse. Reach the target word from the starting word by dropping or adding one letter per turn.
A simple word game where you guess the rhyming pair based on the clue given. 4 daily difficulties for anyone to play.
Wordle-inspired mastermind game. On every guess, you receive the number of letter tiles in the right position, but not the exact position. It's similar to Wordle with a more challenging twist.
Get from one word to the other one hop at a time! Each word along the way must be a real word, no duplicates allowed
Guess the hidden word, then climb: every word you solve is one letter longer, from 4 letters to 10. Miss one and the climb ends. A new climb every day.
Guess words that match the row and column categories. Each square is assigned a rarity score. Rarer answers are better.
Find the hidden overlap between two clues.
What word hides in R-A-E-T-H? Tap the letters back into order. Five words a day, the same for everyone, climbing from four letters to seven.

Spell words, spill tiles, and clear the rearranging 5x5 board (6x6 on Sundays). Tap or drag connecting letters in any direction, chase longer words for bigger bonuses, and swap neighboring tiles to help out.
Starting with three five letter words, join a new word to an old one by changing one letter.  Add as few words as possible until the word web is connected!

Word500 is a word game for power players. After each guess, the three colored tiles on the right (green, yellow, red) show how many letters of your guess are in the secret word, and how many are in the right position.

Fast-paced word game designed for quick, engaging gameplay. With a unique twist where letters fall and can be tapped anywhere on the board to form words, players must beat a 90-second clock. Longer words and rare letters like Q, Z, J, and X yield exponentially higher scores.
A daily Wordle-like game where you have to find all the possible words
Solve three across words stacked top to bottom — a 4, then 5, then 6 letter word, with Wordle-style hints. A vertical axle word runs down the middle, crossing all three. Solving it gives bonus hints!
Connect touching letters in the 4×4 board. Cleared tiles disappear and the waiting letters drop straight down. Choose words until you clear the chute.
Rotate and fit two-letter pieces until every row makes a four-letter word. A theme and one fixed pair give you a starting point.
Create as many words as possible using the center tile.
Daily word-chain puzzle. 8 words, each adjacent pair forms a common two-word phrase; only the first is revealed. A 15-second timer auto-reveals letters, and each one is a strike.
Use tiles to spell words on a never ending board against everyone. Score as many points as you can and compete in the daily challenges.

Find words. Bring down the stones. Clear today's tower. Wordlander is a daily word puzzle where every word you find changes the board. Connect neighboring letters to form words and open a path for each stone to reach the bottom.
Trace words from filled dots to open rings. Your paths can’t cross, and every letter has to belong to a word.

WordRank is a free daily word-guessing game. Each day there's one secret word, and every guess is ranked by how close in meaning it is to the answer, not by letters. Lower rank means you're warmer, higher you're closer.
Play WordReels, the free daily word game where instead of a keyboard, you get spinning letter reels. New 5-letter puzzle every day, 6 attempts to solve.

A daily word game about the history of words. You see only one word's usage curve in books from 1820 to 2019 and get six guesses. Each guess draws its own curve on top, with a % match, an arrow pointing to the right era and any letters in place. Then read the sourced story of the word.
WordSlip is a daily word puzzle on a hexagon grid. Seven letters are scattered across the cells. Unscramble them, then drag a path that spells the word from first letter to last.
Find words using a sequence of letters in exactly the order shown. The first letter must start the word, the last must end it, and any letters in between must appear in order.
Select adjacent tiles to form words. Score based on Scrabble scoring. One hidden target word every day, with Wordle-like hints.
Wordtrak is a new daily word game. Using a limited hand of letters, fill up the 5 traks with words, and keep an eye on the bonus tiles for extra points!
Find two five-letter words that differ by one letter using seven shared guesses, with every guess giving clues for both.
Worduel is the Wordle 1v1 duel. Take turns guessing words. First to solve wins!

Wordle-like game with roguelike elements. Every floor is a boss that hides a word and twists the rules: a duel on a shared board, two or four words at once, a clock, clues that lie or hide in fog. How far can you go?
Literary-based word game. Each day features a new quote or book passage with only some of the letters revealed. Players attempt to complete the passage by guessing all the words.
A daily word hunt on a 4x5 grid: pick one letter per column, left to right, to spell five-letter words; find 10 clued bonus words plus 10 freebies for a perfect 100.

Daily airport-guessing game. Identify a mystery airport from progressive clues — starting with the airlines that operate there, plus traffic data, runways, and more. Five guesses, US mode and World mode.

A red marker drops on a 3D globe. The goal is to name its antipode, the exact opposite point on Earth, in five guesses. Each guess returns a hint with the distance to the target, plus warmer or colder against your last attempt. Countries, oceans and seas all count.
Fly around the globe and deliver packages — drop each one inside the right country. Miss too many times and you'll run out of lives!
Think you know animals? Evolution says otherwise. Guess the species of the day. Learn biodiversity.

Every day, there is exactly one mystery national dish from somewhere around the world. Your goal isn't to spell the name of the dish, but to guess the country it comes from.
With every wrong guess, you get clues about the region or ingredients to help you narrow it down geographically.
Find a city on a blank, 3D globe given only a reference city. If you like MapTap, try this game for an extra challenge!
Draw a country from memory, then watch the real border land on your sketch. Five countries a day, the same for everyone, scored out of 100 each.
Use an interactive compass to estimate the distance and direction from one world capital to another. How close can you get?
Name today's mystery world capital in 6 tries. Each wrong guess gives you distance and direction.
Give two pairs of world capitals, guess which pair is closer together. Each of the 5 rounds gets increasingly more difficult.
Make the shortest loop through cities.
Use an interactive compass to estimate the distance and direction across a trail of world capitals.
A daily game where you find 5 countries on an unlabeled map. Extra points for speed and accuracy!
Two cities with no flight between them. Race from one to the other on real nonstop routes. The fastest trip wins, layovers included.
Guess the city! Guesses will reveal the distance and direction of the guessed city to the target city.

Daily 3×3 geography grid puzzle, like Immaculate Grid for world cities. Each cell needs a city that satisfies both row and column categories (e.g., Landlocked × On a major river). Nine cells, nine guesses, rarity-based scoring — rare correct picks beat obvious ones.
Guess the mystery U.S. college in 8 tries. A free daily Wordle-style game using enrollment, location, school colors, conference, and division as clues.
Name countries like a word chain: each one starts with the last letter of the one before. You start with 30 seconds and every country adds time.
A daily geography drawing challenge: sketch the missing country border on a real map and compare your outline with the real boundary.
Ten quick pairs of countries. Pick the one with more people, or more land. The pairs get closer as you go.
A daily geography puzzle: tap the country that matches two clues at once on an interactive 3D globe — population, economy, culture, and more.

A daily geography game. You get a 360° street-level panorama of somewhere in the world — drop a pin on the map to guess where it is. Five guesses, same location for everyone. Scored by distance in km.

Departle shows you a real departure board, captured from an airport somewhere in the world. The destinations, airlines, gates and statuses are all real, and the board is in the airport's own language. Can you tell where you're standing?
Guess the food and where it's from: a free food guessing game on a world map. 123 dishes from 123 countries.
Identify the country from its outline. Each guess shows distance, direction, and how close you are.
Test your knowledge of parliamentary politics. Guess the country and election year based on the seating plan.
Guess the country from its electricity generation mix
You get two cities. Name a third that is as close as possible to equally far from both. Scored by the gap in km.
A free daily game where a fact meets a map: five questions about the world every day, answered by dropping a pin. The closer your pin, the more points, up to 1,000 a round.
A daily geography trivia game. Five prompts, a pin for each: the fewer people who’d think of your answer, the further it carries you.
A daily geography quiz: name a place for each of seven questions, and the rarer your right answer, the more it scores.
Guess the country from a pie chart of its flag's colors, in 6 tries. Each guess shows how close its colors are, and every miss adds a hint.
Tap through the fog on a globe of flags. Read the flags you uncover to find the country in as few taps as you can

Flagdle is a daily challenge geo guessing game where you can guess flag, shape, capital, currency and many more ! 

This lasts around 2 minutes and get your daily dose of geo fun !
Identify and match country flags, grouping by patterns, colors, symbols, and more!
A daily flag guessing game. The flag starts zoomed in 4x — guess the country and it gradually reveals itself with each wrong attempt. Five guesses, streak tracking, same flag for everyone each day.
Guess the hidden flag in six tries. Every attempt reveals overlapping colors.
Guess the flag by punching holes on a canvas
Solve the crossword by filling in country names in the horizontal rows. Use hints if you get stuck!
a daily grid game where you fill a 3x3 grid with countries that fit the categories in the row and column. There's also a version for the 50 US states.
Pin cities, landmarks, battles, paintings and more on a world map with nothing written on it. How close can you get?
Does the next country rank higher or lower in today's category? 15 calls, three lives – the third wrong guess ends the run.

Every day there is one mystery country. Guess it across several modes — name it by its flag, recognize its map outline, or close in using clues like continent, population, area, distance and direction.
Geographly is a free daily geography quiz. Identify countries by shape, find neighbors, match capitals, and recognize flags. 4 stages and 195+ countries. How well do you know your geography?
Five photos from over a century: drop a pin where each one was taken and guess the year.

Geopolitix is a daily geography game. Each day has 5 rounds: rank countries by stats like population, GDP or soda consumption, guess a country from one of its monuments, and find countries on a blank world map.
A daily geography trivia game where you have to match countries to their highest global statistical rankings, like population or GDP per capita.
Fill all 9 cells on the grid with countries that apply to the categories on each side of the grid.
Resize a country, sea, lake or desert until it matches its true size next to another one. Five rounds, a new geography puzzle every day.
Split the world in half based on a given metric e.g. Native French Speakers. See how close you can get!
GeoTracer gives you one country a day and asks you to draw its border from memory on a globe with no names and no borders visible. You get a score out of 100 when you submit.
Place every country into the category that scores it the most points! The better your match, the higher your daily score.
GlobeHoppr is a geography puzzle game where you navigate from a starting city to a target city by hopping through nearby cities, aiming to reach the target in as few moves as possible.

Each day you see dots for every US location of one mystery chain (restaurants, grocery stores, gas stations, retailers) and get six guesses. Each guess shows the category, whether the chain is bigger or smaller, and how much the two maps overlap.

Headcount gives you a target population each day, then asks you to draw a loop around exactly that many people on a live density map of the world. Read the glowing population dots, lock-in blind, and see how close you got!
A daily geography game where you read the world in color. Every day, a glowing heatmap lights up the globe — figure out which statistic it's hiding.
Daily geography stats game. Two countries appear side by side — click which has the higher value across categories like population, GDP, land area, and more.
Drag outward to guess how wide a real city is, relative to another city.

One region of the world colored by a real number from open data, except one country is showing a fake that blends in with its neighbors. Find the liar in six guesses, then see its real number and why it stands out.
A free daily geography quiz. Ten questions a day, Wordle-style shareable score, plus a live multiplayer mode with four letter room codes.
Find the fastest flight connection between today's cities.
Guess where countries are on a blank, featureless globe. One country is revealed as a point of reference.

Stitch together a daily multi-leg flight itinerary using real airline routes. Connect city A to city B by chaining valid flights, layovers and all. Tests your knowledge of airline networks and hub-and-spoke geography.
Arrange countries into a grid so each neighboring pair shares a border, an official language, or a similar population in this daily geography puzzle.
Every day a new mystery country to find. Start with any country you like, then build a chain where each country starts with a letter from the one before.
Guess which country is the top producer of each part of today's everyday object (like the cocoa, sugar, and milk in a chocolate bar)
Find one hidden country a day. Each clue is a fact that cuts the possibilities in half, and the ruled-out part of the map literally folds away until you can name it.
You're given one chance to pinpoint each of the 5 provided cities by tapping on a 3D globe. How close can you get? Historical facts about the locations are revealed after each round!
Guess the country by it's military equipment. Each guess unlocks continent, region, capability, and distance feedback.
A network visualization based game where you guess a mystery node based on a graph of its connections. In this mode, guess the country based on the countries it borders.
Virtually meet a new Originle guest every day, listen to their hints, and guess the country they are representing!
One mystery country a day, worked out over five rounds: a landmark photo, build its flag, name its neighbors, its capital, and its size.

Daily city-guessing game with a vintage passport aesthetic. Six travel clues (high temp, population, elevation, local time, landscape, top airlines) revealed one at a time as you guess. Five attempts to identify the mystery city. Stamp your passport when you nail it.
Pop culture has a postcode, pin it. Pin facts to the places they belong. Rarer answers score more points.
Turn a plane on a world map with no labels, set how far it flies, then watch the map roll into a globe to see how close you land to the city.

Where does a drop of rain reach the sea? A raindrop falls somewhere on Earth. Follow it downhill through real rivers and tap where you think it ends. Four tries, and within 100 km wins. The reveal traces its whole journey, sometimes thousands of kilometers.
Try to guess the randomly selected country name in 7 tries.
Every day this game picks one mystery country and shows you the 5 Wikipedia articles people there read the most yesterday. Work out which country it is in 6 guesses or fewer.
Draw the missing border between neighboring countries.
Every day, a new geographic heat map appears on Redacted Maps. Colors are visible, but the legend is classified. You get multiple guesses to figure out what the data represents.
Drag the needle of the compass to point from City A toward City B along the shortest path.
Plan one US road trip a day. Match the six stop requirements in as few miles as you can.
Guess the daily country from its clues. Every guess launches a shrimp across the map, and it gets pinker the closer you are.

Daily Wordle-style flight guessing game. Identify a real flight from progressive clues — duration, aircraft type, domestic/international, direction, and operating airline. Five guesses per day. Includes US-only mode and a sister suite of aviation puzzles (AirportQ, CityQ, PassportQ).
Daily geography game about famous faces: read the clue, spin the globe, tap the country then the city where their story happened.

Name the statistic behind today’s world heatmap. Every guess paints its own map and scores how closely the two match, while a chameleon dances in his disco room, changing color to show how close you are.
A grid game for US states. Fill the grid by correctly guessing the state which matches both categories on the sides of the grid.
Locate all 50 US States, 3,143 counties and major cities in this daily geography quiz game!

A daily statistics game about US States. Each day, compare 7 states across 4 modes — find the highest, the lowest, the closest, or the impostor hiding among real data. From population to obesity rate, how well do you really know the 50 states?
Peel back a 3D map of a mystery city 1 layer at a time. Terrain, weather, water, roads, then buildings. Guess the city in five layers!

TerraeQuest is a daily geography game with 4 unique modes: spot the country with the fake stat, find the highest or lowest value, and get as close as possible to the target. New puzzles every day, real country data, and a streak to protect.
A daily landmark-pinpointing game. Everyone gets the same 5 world landmarks each day. Zoom in on a 3D globe, drop one pin per landmark, and score up to 5,000 points each for how close you get.
Daily challenges where you travel the world and find the fastest route from start to end destinations using real world flight, train, buss and ferry lines.
Travel from one country to another by naming every country in between. Build the path to win.
Draw the country's flag from memory, and see how close you get!
Identify a mystery city from 7 days of its real weather — highs, lows, rain and wind.
A silhouette, a name, an empty world map: move the map under the crosshair to where the animal lives, then see its real range.
Using Google Street view to determine the location.
A daily language guessing game — listen to audio samples and guess the language being spoken.
Point the direction a real river, road, or route runs, then see the real answer on a map.

Play a daily geography guessing game, practice with custom country quizzes, explore country profiles, and browse world data on World Clue. Guess the country based on hints like terrain, GDP, and fertility rate.
A geography game where the worm digs deeper with rarer answers
Name the city from a map with no labels, zoomed in to 500 metres. Each skip zooms the map out but costs points. A new city every day, with a daily leaderboard.
Make every dice roll equal 37. Combine your dice with math operations to hit the target.
Group like colors and unscramble the board

A Daily loop puzzle set in Amsterdam. Draw one continuous canal that flows through every open square exactly once, curving around houses, windmills, and tulip fields, never crossing a wall and never touching itself. A single closed loop.

Estimate an angle by building it again - An angle appears on a dial for three seconds, then vanishes - and the reference line it was drawn against moves. Your job is to rebuild the angle from memory: drag the dial until it looks the same as what you saw.
Play a daily resource management puzzle. Enclose magical plants, balance ingredients, and complete potion recipes to maximize your score.
Clear the board by tapping arrows whose exit paths are free

An irregular object sits above a fulcrum. Slide the fulcrum to the one point where the object would hold level, then let go and watch! You are guessing where the weight of the shape really lies, not where the middle is.
A new twist on nonograms and picross. Fill the grid with bells and whistles using the clues on the rows and columns to work out what symbol goes where
Daily blackjack game where everyone plays the same five hands! See how you stack up on the leaderboard.
A memory-based slicing game where you try to split shapes 50:50, choosing between a safer visible cut or more precise adjustments from memory.
A daily flood-fill puzzle. Start from a corner and flood the grid with colors to cover every cell in as few moves as possible.
A challenging, but fun daily math puzzle. Place the specified number of berries into each row, column, and block.
Wordle for Chess Puzzles! You get a number of attempts to solve the puzzle by choosing the best series of moves for both players. Every attempt gives Wordle-style colored feedback.
Daily puzzle game inspired by classic box-drawing strategy game. Place lines to complete boxes and score points indicated inside the box. Play the daily gambit, or a full game!
Draw one continuous line through every bubble across three daily sheets shared by all players
A hexagonal puzzle where you color each hex cell black or yellow to satisfy the target sums along the edges
A daily network puzzle: link every dot so the network survives when the worst zone breaks, then try to hit par as fast as you can. Each day is harder than the last, up to a tricky weekend.
A free daily cage math puzzle — fill cages to hit the target using +, ×, −, ÷. New puzzle every day
Place eight pieces on a calendar board so the only cells left uncovered are today's month and date.

A daily patchwork puzzle. Click tiles to rotate them so neighboring colors line up. A fresh quilt each day.

Logging in is entirely optional and only required for saving scores to the leaderboard.
Cancel numbers so row and column sums match!
Improve your chess skills with daily puzzles which get more difficult throughout the week. Sharpen your skills with puzzles made to improve pattern recognition.
Crack today's color code. Six guesses. One sequence.
CodePop is a free daily colour puzzle game inspired by the classic Mastermind board game. A new code to crack every day!

A daily flood it puzzle with a twist. Instead of filling the whole board, you flood tiles to open one unbroken stretch of sea from the top left corner to Ithaca in the bottom right, before your move budget runs out.

Counted is a daily counting game you can't count in. A scene appears - books on a shelf, a crowd of people, grapes on a bunch, stars in a sky - for just long enough to look at and never long enough to count. Then it goes dark and you say how many there were.

A daily origami puzzle. You fold a square of paper until it matches a target outline. There are three levels each day (Easy, Medium and Hard, with 2, 3 and 4 folds) plus a bonus Master level with 6 folds on a finer grid.
Queens-style logic puzzle: place one crown in every row, column and color region, no two crowns touching diagonally. One unique solution per day.
Click/touch and drag to cut the shape. Try for a 50:50 ratio by cutting evenly. You only have one chance per day. Shapes can be cut from any angle.

D3C1PH3R is a daily code-breaking challenge. Each day of the week brings a new hidden number sequence — starting with 3 digits on Monday and scaling up to 6 by Sunday. Use logic, process of elimination, and nerve to crack the code before your guesses run out.
Daily Akari is a block-based puzzle game where you place lights by arranging blocks and try to satisfy the level conditions (e.g. lights blocked off and no lights in certain spaces).
Pair every tree with a tent, keep tents apart, and match the row and column counts.

A secret math rule is hidden each day and you have to deduce it just by testing three digit numbers that either get accepted or rejected by the rule. Form a hypothesis in your mind, then see if you're right!
A paper is folded and holes are punched, the player needs to mark where the holes will appear when the paper is unfolded. 3 puzzles daily with easy, medium and hard difficulties.
Find the hidden mathematical sequence along with its transformation rule.
Each day brings three stages drawn from words, numbers, shapes, emoji and cards. Spot the rule that connects the clues.
A daily dungeon card game based on Scoundrel. Take three of the four cards in each room (monsters, weapons and potions) and clear the deck before your health runs out.
Crack a newly invented language and its script every day, then prove it in a quiz without your notes.
Seat everyone, keep the peace. A new table every day.

Does Monday Work? is a daily calendar puzzle where your schedule slowly turns into chaos. Place events, discover new rules, rearrange your plans, and somehow make the whole month work. A small indie game made for people who enjoy puzzles that make them stop and think.
Give Dusty the robot vacuum a few moves, and it repeats them until every crumb is gone. A bump skips a move.
A puzzle that echoes your every move. Get the yellow chip into the center of the board by letting it echo your other moves. Its fun and challenging!
A daily puzzle game where you build enclosures around horses by placing walls on a grid. The goal is simple: keep the horse safe inside the largest possible enclosure using a limited number of walls.
eight small boards to untangle each day, the same for everyone. drag the dots until no lines cross, and each shape you free becomes a stamp to collect.
Turn the mirrors, then shine two lasers: one red dot for Fibs the cat, one for Rex the dog. You get 3 shots a day. Every room has exactly one winning pair of beams.
Flip the corners of a two-sided paper sheet until it is all white and matches the dashed outline. Each Daily has three puzzles, with stars for solving in fewer flips.
Fill in the 2d slots so that it folds into the cube. 3 spatial puzzles a day.
A daily Connect Four endgame. The position is already won for you in four moves and exactly one column keeps it, with a perfect engine playing out the rest.
Every day everyone gets the same board — clear the grid of apples by matching adjacent numbers that add up to 10. One shot a day: build your streak and climb the global leaderboard.
Group colored points on the grid into districts to win the election.
Plan your slides across three icy boards in this sliding puzzle.
Watch a marble move, then redraw its path and speed from memory. A new daily run every day, scored on shape and timing. F
Help Grandma knit today's picture. Each number is a run of knitted squares in its row or column. Knit them all right and the picture appears in her yarns.
Find a function that starts at the green point, avoids the blue obstacles, and reaches the red target. Build your streak and challenge your friends!
Cut five 3D objects exactly in half by weight. A new daily set takes about three minutes.
Cut everyday objects into 2 equal halves, more difficult than it sounds! A solid object appears - a pear, a bottle, a fish, a nail - place one cut through it so that the two pieces weigh the same.
Combine intercepted clues to crack a safe containing four unique digits in four attempts. Collect loot, unlock backgrounds and music with earned in-game money, and return for a new vault every day.
Fill a hexagon grid in as few moves as possible
Every day, a 19-cell honeycomb board and a fresh set of hex pieces. Your job: fit them all with as few moves as possible.
A math puzzle game that combines number merging with simple arithmetic. Sum tiles, subtract negatives, and multiply with × tiles to grow one giant final tile. The largest tile wins the day.

Place one dog beside each fire hydrant, keep the dogs from touching, and match every row and column count. Solve the game and watch the pups mark their territory in this very dog-friendly take on the classic Trees and Tents logic puzzle!
A hungry wolf is circling, and your herd needs to get home. Guide sheep, pigs, and cows to safety with 30 whistles, before the wolf can get them!
Rotate, scale and arrange shapes to solve a huge variety of levels. A completely fresh take on spatial reasoning.
Solve the daily puzzle by identifying three Fibonacci-like sequences connected by one shared number, using 10 of the given numbers.

A daily Japanese puzzle box. Slide the blocks along their grain and turn the box to bring the black key down to its brass lock. Every box holds a one-of-a-kind keepsake for your shelf, finished in gold leaf if you open it in par. Can you?
Kode is a daily four-digit code-breaking puzzle. Instead of guessing blind, you're handed a board of graded clues and deduce the combination by pure logic ,one solution, no trial and error.
Each knot in Lacey the spider's web shows how many threads it held. Spin the right threads to mend it into one web.
Seven bottles, five colors, poured into each other. Sort them until every color has a bottle to itself.
A daily grid puzzle. Ask row and column questions, place letters on a 3×3 or 4×4 board, and lock in for Wordle-style feedback.
Swap colored shapes on a small grid until all of the day's rules, like "No triangle touches a circle," are true at once.

Ledger Lock is a daily number-logic puzzle. Toggle cells on the grid so every row and column adds up to its target sum — but no two selected cells can be adjacent. One unique solution each day, with streak tracking and shareable results.
Type letters and they appear on the screen - move them around to form target shape. Inspired by the FedEx logo where E and X form an arrow.
A family tells you what they saw, but one of them is lying. Move them around the room to catch the liar!
Connect every bulb and the power plug with one loop of wire. Walls and gaps narrow down the route. Close the circuit to light the string.
Draw a path between each pair of matching dots. Paths cannot cross, and every square on the board has to be used.
A daily mirrors and light logic puzzle.
Lay dominoes on a grid so no row or column repeats a number
60 seconds to solve 20 math problems, same problems for everyone for the day. Can you solve them all before you run out of time?
You have to find a simple addition or subtraction in less than 5 tries. Each guess must be a valid equation. Use a smart strategy and share the result.
A daily mental math sprint. Everyone gets the same 20 problems, races one clock, and is graded against everyone else that day.
A daily Minesweeper challenge!

A daily minesweeper challenge where everyone gets the same board. Numbered tiles indicate how many adjacent mines there are to that tile. Clear the board, but be careful, you only get one chance to get it right!
Mini Mahj Daily is a free once-a-day mahjong challenge. Everyone in the world gets the same tiles. See how you did on the leaderboard, or create groups to play against your friends.
Motion Path is a minimalist memory game with three modes: redraw a hidden path, replace vanished dots, or keep a rhythm from memory.
Murder-mystery logic puzzles with daily cases, unique solutions, and an editor.
A pure logic deduction puzzle where you have to return cats and dogs to their homes by following the clues at each step.
A logic game with a splash of trivia! Use the clues to figure out which elements match across categories!
A daily picture-logic puzzle, also known as Picross. Fill the grid from the number clues to reveal a hidden picture.
Click squares on a colorful, number-filled grid. Each click increases the number in the square. Adjacent squares with the same number will be crunched and removed from the grid. Can you clear it?
Tap a square, enter a positive number that fits both the column and row conditions, and prove it. Every square needs a different number - reusing one gets rejected.
Each day there is a new target number. Get to the target using only the provided numbers and operations (+, -, * or /)
A daily number deduction puzzle inspired by Bulls and Cows / Mastermind. Guess a secret 4-digit number using only + and - clues.
Each day, grow a factor tree working backwards from the target number.
Packing puzzle game. The goal is to pack these items while meeting some fun constraints.
Draw the district lines so the smaller side wins the map. A gerrymandering puzzle.
Flip cards and match every pair in as few moves as you can. One new board a day, same for everyone.
Start with a red paperclip and trade your way up to the day's prize in as few swaps as you can. Each trader swaps only once, and some trades lead nowhere.
A daily sliding-block puzzle. A jammed six by six lot, blocks that each slide on one axis, and a red block that has to reach the one gap in the wall.

Daily puzzle game. Your goal is to find the gems. There are a few simple rules which are always true: 1. At least one box tells the truth. 2. At least one box lies. 3. Exactly one box has gems in it. The others are empty.

Pathways is a daily puzzle that's part problem-solving exercise and part meditation. There isn't one right pathway. There are many. Your pathway may not look like your friend's — and that's part of the charm. If you follow the rules and fill the grid, your pathway is valid.
Listen to a sequence of bells and play it back. It grows each round. One daily sequence for everyone.
Use deduction to draw paths of different lengths with an X and O at each endpoint.
Guess which perimeter is longer. Two shapes, 7 rounds.
A daily visual memory game where you memorize pixel art, redraw it from memory, and compare your score with other players.
Fill the canvas with rectangles, no two the same shape, as even in size as you can. Every solution is a painting. A new canvas every day.

A Wordle-style site for puzzlehunt-style puzzles, like those in Puzzled Pint or the MIT Mystery Hunt. A puzzle is an open-ended challenge typically consisting of a title, flavor text, and body, which solves to a word or phrase.
A colourful polyomino puzzle game where the goal is to fill a 7x7 board by rotating and placing pieces.
A 7x7 grid split into ponds, each showing how many ducks it holds. Same-pond ducks must all touch; ducks from different ponds must never touch. Simple rules, satisfying logic.
A daily king-and-pawn chess endgame: find the proven promotion in a fixed number of moves.
Daily visual memory challenge. You have just 6 seconds to memorize 6 objects before recreating their positions, shapes and colors.
Lead Rex the dog through every square of the yard to the ball without crossing his own trail.
One reasoning riddle every day, with progressive hints, open-answer checking, a clear explained solution, and a calendar/archive of previous puzzles.

A daily logic puzzle where you fill a grid with numbers in sequence. The shade of each square tells you whether the next number must be 1, 2 or 3 squares away, moving horizontally or vertically. Each puzzle has a single solution, with a new challenge every day.
A daily logic puzzle: order a scrambled number grid by tapping the center of any 2x2 block to rotate it (clockwise or counter-clockwise) until the whole grid is in order.
Daily American roulette game where everyone plays the same five spins and climbs the leaderboard.
Climb the grid using math to land exactly on the day’s target. It comes in easy, medium and hard boards.
Slide matching trays under layers of colored sand. Filled trays clear space for the others.

Daily number logic puzzle. Fill a grid divided into sections. Each section must contain numbers 1 through its length with no repeats. A fresh alternative to Sudoku with a unique twist. New puzzle every day, with 5 exclusive puzzles for Listdle users!
Seedle is a crop farming puzzle game. Place your crops in the most optimal way to gain the highest possible score!

Daily Mental Math Challenge. Every day, solve 7 calculations. For each one, you get 6 numbers and a target number between 101 and 999. Your goal is to get as close as possible by combining the given numbers with 4 operations (+, -, × and ÷).
Find the secret connected path of 4 tiles in 6 tries. A new puzzle drops every day!
A daily number sequence puzzle - like Wordle but for maths. Find the pattern, guess the missing number. Three guesses, streak tracking, shareable results.
You see shapes constantly. Let's see how well you remember them. This game shows you 5 shapes, then you must recreate them from memory.
3d rotation analysis game and you have to figure out which box is the same
Draw rectangles, match every number to its area, and find the one correct solution.

You are given a grid with numbers scattered across it. Your goal is to divide the entire grid into non-overlapping rectangles, so that each rectangle contains exactly one number and that number equals the rectangle's area.
Three simple rules. Divide the grid into rectangles. Put exactly one number in each rectangle. It tells you the area. Cover every cell, with no overlaps.

A daily forest-themed logic puzzle. Forage exactly two mushrooms in every row, column, and colored dirt patch, with none touching, not even diagonally. Mark safe squares with grass and avoid the poisonous ones. Three timed sizes daily, from Easy 8x8 to Hard 12x12.
A daily 6x6 mini sudoku: every row, column and 2x3 box holds 1 to 6. One logical solution, notes and a free hint, harder on Sundays.
A daily sliding puzzle. Push the ball, it slides until it hits something, and land it on the ring in as few pushes as possible. Three boards a day, and every board has exactly one perfect route
Slidesmith is an original daily sliding puzzle: slide tiles to build five patterns on one board, with exactly enough moves for each.
A daily packing puzzle. Bendy tube-shaped pieces have to snake around fixed bumps in a tray and fit together with no gaps. You drag pieces in, tap to turn them, and earn stars for using fewer hints.
A daily liquid sort puzzle. Test tubes filled with colored layers — pour them between tubes until each one holds a single color.
Most people think they have a good ear. Some people are wrong. Listen to 5 sounds, then try to recreate them from memory.
A daily physics stacking game. Place falling shapes and build the tallest stable tower you can.
Classic daily 9x9 Sudoku with four fresh difficulties every day, a notes mode, instant conflict highlighting, and per-difficulty timing.
A cross between Wordle and classic Sudoku, where you guess each row of the puzzle before using Wordle-style clues to solve the rest.
Like Sudoku, but numbers repeat.

Summit is a daily number pyramid puzzle. The top tile is fixed. Rearrange the remaining numbers so that every tile equals the sum of the two below it. Simple rules, satisfying logic, and harder than it might seem.
A logic placement puzzle where you place one rex per row, column, and colour region, none touching, so the digits beneath all six add up to today's target. One solution, no guessing required.
Sums is a daily number-placement puzzle where the arithmetic is simple, but the spatial reasoning is the challenge. Hand-crafted puzzles, a daily leaderboard, and hints if you get stuck.
Use your math skills to perform operations on the numbers and hit the target!
A daily number puzzle. Two tiles are marked; draw one path between them that adds up to the highest score. Some numbers are negative. 3 new puzzles every day (Easy, Medium and Hard).
Drag a path of touching tiles that adds up to the target. 60-second run, every target solvable, same grid daily.

Fill the grid with suns and moons so that every row and column ends up perfectly balanced, with no three of the same symbol ever sitting in a row. A few cells come pre-filled, and a handful of '=' and '×' hints on the edges between certain cells tell you when two neighbors must match or must differ.
Solve the daily Tangram puzzle! Fit all seven pieces inside the outline, flat, with no gaps and no overlaps.
Move Tato the hamster around the board and dig every grass tile in as few moves as possible.
Threezy is a card puzzle inspired by the game SET. Spot a "set" of three cards where shape, color, fill, and count are each all-same or all-different, as fast as you can!

A football-themed logic puzzle where you have to find the one passing sequence that works. Thread the ball through every teammate exactly once, avoid defenders, don’t cross your own previous passes, and finish with a clean shot into the net!
You experience time constantly. Let's see how good you are at measuring it. Try to re-create 5 durations from memory.
Every line counts its colors. Fill in the board so all lines agree.
Help the Kid dig up the backyard treasure. Each number counts the treasure in the 8 squares around it. Flag every treasure and the Kid digs them up. A new map every day, no guessing needed.
A daily sliding puzzle where three pieces move as one. Slide the trio onto their goal squares — the movement rule changes each weekday, building a weekly arc.
