A ball is thrown, watch the start of an arc, then call where the ball lands before it gets there!
Guess the DSM-5 medical diagnosis using 6 clues.
A daily 3-question quiz: “Which happened earlier?” Sounds easy, until it isn't. Challenge your timeline instincts and come back each day for a new set. Share and compete with friends.
A daily history game: five fictional eyewitnesses describe one moment in history, one voice at a time – pin where and when it happened on a globe and a timeline. Fewer voices, more points.
Eliminate all but the earliest historical event from the given 8. The last elimination is the hardest.
Seven moments from history a day, same for everyone. Guess the year. The closer you get, the further you travel.

See a real historical photograph. Drop a pin on where it happened. Scroll to the year. EraPin is a free daily history and geography game — 5 rounds, up to 25,000 points. New event every day, plus an archive of previous days.
A fun, 2-minute daily estimation game. Guess the numbers behind five interesting real-world facts and see how good your intuition really is over your morning coffee.
Make five estimates each day, ranging from years and distances to quantities and more. Get as close as you can, compare your guesses with other players, and discover surprising facts along the way.
One real animal: drag to set how fast you think its heart beats, then see the real heart beat beside yours.
Extrapolate historic graphs as accurately as possible over multiple categories
Each day you get six scatter charts of real data, see where four things land, and place the fifth.
7 offbeat news stories, 5 true, 2 false. Map the true ones. Every point drops his jaw deeper.
A daily estimation puzzle game. You get three questions and one guess each, to land as close to the real answer as possible. You're scored on how close you get, as a multiple.
Big questions, no calculator: how many heartbeats in a day? Estimate, see how many times off you were, then follow the worked answer. Five a day.
Find the needle in a haystack!
One section of a flag is missing, try to guess its exact color.
Flip five everyday objects and land each upright. Three throws per object in a new daily challenge that takes about four minutes.
Players arrive one at a time and you slot each into one of 12 categories: club, nationality, league or award. The right slot locks the box, a wrong one shakes it but you can keep going.
Sort 16 footballers into 4 hidden groups of 4. Each group shares something - same team, same nation, same position or same age. You get 4 mistakes. A new grid every day.
A daily guessing football game. Find the stadium where this iconic moment happened!
The daily football club crossover puzzle. Fill the 3x3 grid by naming a footballer who played for both intersecting clubs. 9 guesses, a new grid every day!
Name the club by looking at its crest through a small peephole that widens with each wrong answer.
Wordle for footballers: crack the name the player goes by. The word length changes every day and each guess colors in like classic Wordle.
Guess the mystery footballer from a blurred photo and a few clues. A new player every day, solve it in fewer guesses and faster to boost your Footy IQ.
Daily NBA trivia game built around deep cuts: one new puzzle a day that rewards real hoops knowledge over the obvious names
Fumbll is a daily fantasy football guessing game: 6 guesses to name the mystery NFL player, with clue-based feedback on team, position, age, fantasy points, and more.
Recreate a country flag's missing colour with hue, saturation and brightness sliders.
The daily where + when sports quiz. Five famous sports moments a day: pin where each happened on a 3D globe and guess the year. Football, cricket, F1, tennis, rugby, golf and more.
Spin the reel, draft real pros into the attribute slots, then simulate their entire career.
Gradientle - the daily color puzzle: align colored tiles, so that a perfect 2D gradient is created!
Griductive is a daily deductive logic puzzle game. Play as a detective and classify each character on the grid as Suspect or Innocent — using only logical clues.
A daily stadium-guessing challenge. You're dropped into a locked panoramic view of a ground and have to name the home club before time expires. Faster answers keep more points.
Discover new restaurants by guessing what's on their menu. Beat the daily challenge and try local mode to unlock spots near you—and maybe your next meal.
The NBA player guessing game. Try to guess the mystery player in 10 tries using hints. A new mystery player every day at midnight EST!
How many grapes weigh as much as a football? Set the count, then watch the balance scale tip. Five estimation rounds a day, with real weights from official sources.

Guessmint is a free daily history guessing game where players identify a real antique coin by determining which country, state or tribe issued it and approximately in what era it was struck. A world history game, one coin a day.
Guess the year five real newspaper headlines were published. New puzzle daily, same headlines for every player, shareable results.
Work out who’s telling the truth and who’s lying from their clues and one daily rule.
NHL Player Guessing Game. Every guess will reveal info like team, conference, division, position, age, nation, and jersey number.
Guess the colour of #Hexle in 6 tries! How well do you know your hex colors? After each guess, see how close your color is to the target.
Daily guessing game with three challenges on history's greatest figures, inventions, and events. New challenges every day.
Place famous “firsts” in chronological order, from groundbreaking inventions to major discoveries and historical milestones. A new history ranking challenge every day.
Uncover the event using as few clues as possible, testing your knowledge of history in a concise daily format. The game is presented as a daily history quiz, with one new event available each day.
A real estate guessing game. Guess the list price of houses! Each guess reveals a new photo from the listing.
Drag the shape to guess the size of a real thing, against a reference that never changes.
One item, one place, one date: set the price it cost, then see the real price from official price statistics.
Guess how likely something is to happen (like hitting a royal flush), from 1 in 1 to 1 in a billion, then see how close other players got.
Drag up or down to guess how many people fit in a real place.
Pull a slider up to guess the amount of sugar in a real product.
Guess how much wacky things cost, from weird auction items to cars to companies!
Try to guess the theme of the color palette. Each wrong guess reveals a hint, or if you are confident, play on artist mode, where each failed guess does not earn a clue.

Color gradient puzzle game - with a fresh board every day. Rearrange the tiles to form a perfect gradient across the grid. Your goal is to complete the grid in the least moves and fastest time. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.
How sharp are your eyes? In this game, you must identify the colored tile on the grid which has a slightly different hue than the others. Each round gets more difficult.
Match a target color by feel before the clock runs out. One Daily Hue puzzle a day with a shareable score grid, plus easy and practice modes.
A daily trivia game where every answer is a number. Six guesses, with hot-and-cold feedback on each.
Put your football knowledge to the test! Immaculate Grid is a daily trivia game powered by Sports Reference. Come back for a new NFL grid challenge every day!
Guess the price of all sorts of items with higher and lower hints. Household items, luxury fashion, homes, and art.
Guess the year of the event. After each guess, get feedback based on how far you are from the actual year. Hints available if you get stuck
Guess the football (soccer) player based on their jersey, club history, debut, teammate, and nationality. A new player each day.

Dily football true/false quiz. Each day one category is marked “Today's challenge” (players, clubs, nations, global championships, transfers, etc.). Play 10 cards with a 12-second timer per question; swipe right for True, left for False (or tap ✓/✕).
A daily mini golf challenge. Navigate tricky obstacles and sink the ball with as few shots as you can!
One tangled question a day. Underneath it is a plain number question like "How far is the Moon?", but it's wrapped in double negatives and other twisty wording.
Guess languages based on their language family
Manage real MLB postseason games from every October since 1970. Pick either dugout, get every call graded, and see how other players called it.
Solve the daily minigame to unlock the featured star, then spin four teammates from pro basketball history under a salary cap, play out an 82-game season and climb the daily leaderboard.
Wordle for fitness lovers! Guess the exercise, and get hints based attributes like muscle group, equipment, movement pattern, and more.
Guess the gym exercise from heat map of activated muscles and equipment.
A daily language grid puzzle. Find the language which matches the facts on the sides of the grid.
Find the links between players that have played with or against each other in at least one World Cup Match.
Real estate price guessing game. Guess the sale price of a recently sold property!
Use a color palette to guess the brand color of the logo shown in grayscale. One guess per day.
A daily contraption puzzle. The machine is almost built: drag the last parts into place, press Run and watch the chain reaction.
Test your estimation skills with a new mind-bending question every day. How close can you get?
Across 3 statewide races, use the information given to peg down what year the election was held.
A spatial memory game. Marks appear one by one on an empty board, then vanish: tap where they were.
A daily history guessing game: could Mozart have seen a hot air balloon? Twelve cards a day, each answer proved on a timeline drawn to scale.

The family tree of the plant kingdom (which scientists call Viridiplantae) is broad and beautiful... but also complex! Metaflora is a game that tests your green thumb by seeing how well you can navigate its leafy branches.

Metazooa is a game that tests how well you know our extended family tree. Your goal is to figure out today's Animal in as few guesses as possible. Wrong guesses will narrow down the answer by taxonomic rank (kingdom, phylum, class, order, etc.)
Guess the dish from its ingredients. Six clues reveal one at a time, hardest first, and every miss adds a clue.
A legendary historical starting 11 is presented with 3 players hidden. Can you complete the iconic lineup based on the team's formation and year?
A color mixing game. See a color, pick the paints that made it in equal parts, and stir. Three colors a day.

MLB player name chain game. Users need to connect a starting player, middle player, and end player using active and former all-star MLB players. The chain is formed from the first letter of the starting player's last name. The next player's 1st name needs to start with that same letter. Ex. Pete Alonso --> Aaron Judge.
A new foggy maze every day, same one for everyone. Guide Mochi through the fog, dodge ghosts, outrun the Hunter and beat the clock.
Every morning, a new little mystery shakes out over breakfast at the caravan. Read the clues, catch the lies, and work the grid to win!
A daily art puzzle: name the painting in six guesses. Each one tells you how close you are.
Play NFL Wordle, the daily player guessing game! Inspired by Wordle and Weddle, can you guess the NFL player from the clues? A new challenge is released every day!
A cricket-themed Wordle. Each guess reveals attributes about the cricket player.
Guess the price and fill in the blank nutrition facts information of a random food item!
Twelve rooms. Nine torches. One daily dungeon. Grab treasure, dodge traps, and decide when to walk away. How far will you push your luck?
Draw one line and drop the marble into the cup.
An animal or a country’s people: how many hours a day do they sleep, eat or work?
Bid upward on a real-world number you can't look up. A bid that stays under tells you only "still under". Go over and the round is worth nothing.
Guess the year of creation of a gallery of paintings!
Daily color mixing puzzle. Match a target color by adjusting RGB and CMY sliders — scored by perceptual color distance.
Daily football game: two players, one season, one figure. The first one's is given: does the second have more or fewer? Goals, assists, matches, yellow cards. Ten duels, one mistake and it's over.
Guess the invention from a real patent drawing. One mystery patent a day from the US archives, six guesses, with clues straight from the file, filing date, scale, class, and the redacted claim.
Humans are wired to spot broken patterns. Let's see how fast you can fix one.
A daily picture puzzle. Reveal cells, recognize the image, and protect your score.
MLB Player Guessing Game. Guesses reveal player information like team, division, batting stance, position, and age.
A daily game where you guess the pixelated image, every wrong guess brings it more into focus.
A daily football (soccer) guessing game. Use logical clues like team, nation, position, age, and shirt number to find the mystery player of the day in 8 guesses. No sign-up required.
A daily test of physical intuition. Water in a tilted glass, a wheel slowing down, a hidden lamp, how long things last and a vanishing pool shot.
NBA Player Guessing Game. Guess the player based on current team, position, and measurables. Do you know ball?
POUR is a daily 3D game with an eye test. One glass is tipped into another, and you guess where the liquid will land. There are five pours a day.
A volume estimation game. A drink in one glass is poured into another: mark where it will reach. Three pours a day.

Five real items a day with real prices as of a stated date: an Amazon find, a new car, a home for sale, a flight or hotel stay, and a luxury piece. Five guesses at each with a hint after every guess, one score out of 50, and a daily leaderboard.

PricedIn is a daily price-guessing game that tests your knowledge of what things actually cost in 6 different years. From fast food to modern fashion, you have three tries to nail the price for each year. It's "The Price is Right" meets Wordle - can you get it right?
Step onto the market desk and value five transfers. Read each deal, set your fee, and try to beat the market. The closer your guess to the real fee, the more points you bank.
Higher or lower with launch prices in today's money: did a 1977 Atari 2600 cost more than a PS5? A daily chain of ten calls, plus an endless streak mode.
A daily game where you classify conspiracies as real or not. Test your historical knowledge and see how much you actually know.
Guess the NHL players that fit into the different categories provided on the grid.
How many times has “password123” been leaked? Each day you get five real passwords and guess how often each one turned up in data breaches. The closer you get, the more you score.
Five real S&P 500 charts a day with tickers and dates hidden. Call up or down over the next five trading days and see what actually happened.
Reciple gives you a recipe card with the dish's name torn off. Carbonara or cacio e pepe? Pho or ramen? Read the ingredients, make a guess, and watch the ones you got right light up.
A daily estimation puzzle, mixing educated guesswork with a bit of timed mental arithmetic

A daily word puzzle game set in the fictional city of Caldmere. Each day, you're handed a redacted police file document, key words have been blacked out, and it's your job to figure out what's hidden beneath.
A daily regex puzzle: write one pattern that catches every target word and spares every decoy, in as few characters as you can.
Guess the photo from a tiny close-up, every wrong guess zooms out a bit more. 5 images per day, 4 tries per image, get the highest score with a maximum of 500 points.
Seven numbers to estimate each day, one guess each. The closer your measure, the further your knight travels.
Defeat 8 monsters by choosing the optimal 7+ items each day! Will you choose holy burn? High crit glass canon? An unkillable vampire tank? Choose everyday on Roguedle!
Connect two athletes by building a chain using other players they shared a team with. Try creating shorter and/or rarer routes than the competition! NBA, NFL, and MLB modes!
Relaxing photo puzzle game. Rotate the pieces to unscramble the photo.

Western history trivia game with a roguelike twist. Each day brings one category and five clues, four choices each, with payouts rising as the clues get harder. Spend your winnings on items in the shop.
One real food or drink a day. Fill a plate or pour glasses of another until it holds the same energy, then see the real amount, from two official food tables.
A size guessing game: stretch an object to its real size next to one you know, from coins to the Eiffel Tower. Five pairs a day, plus unlimited play.
The daily puzzle for fragrance lovers. Up to six guesses to name today's fragrance from its notes and infos.
SCOUT is a daily hockey guessing game. One NHL player is picked each morning, the same one for everybody, and you have eight guesses to work out who he is.
Daily list of stadium food from around the world, guess what the majority of other guessers would rather eat.
3 new unbelievable images or videos drop every day, and you vote on whether each is a "Snapshot" (real) or a "Shamshot" (AI/Edited).
Guess the day’s event in history from its clues. Every guess flings a hermit crab across the ages, and he points the way: earlier or later.
Shift — a daily sliding puzzle where everyone solves the same puzzle and races the clock to see who's fastest.
Five quick micro-games back to back: pick the bigger expression, spot the odd one out, and guess which happened first. A fast paced game - try to complete all of them in under 60 seconds!

Size It Up is a daily visual estimation game where you resize one object to match its real-world scale against another. Test your sense of size with everything from animals and landmarks to everyday objects, then see how close you got.
3x3 sliding puzzle built from a new photo each day. Solve it in as few moves as possible and see how you stack up against the optimal solution (and your friends).
Guess the famous figure from five clues.
SoReal is a daily challenge: two images appear side by side, and you get one chance daily to determine which one you think is AI generated.
Crack the hidden RGB color in 6 guesses using hot/cold feedback per channel.
Daily player guessing game! Premier League, Euroleague, NBA, NHL, NFL, and Formula 1 options!
Daily player guessing game! Soccer (football), Golf, Cricket, Formula 1 & Tennis options!
Sports Connections is a sports themed puzzle game where you must group words in the grid by a common attribute.
A daily game where you turn random Squiggles into Doodles, then vote on your favorites!
Daily NBA trivia. 5 players, 12 questions, 10-second shot clock, about a minute.
NBA Stats guessing game built from real all-time career numbers. Three game modes, Over/Under, Career Clash, and Hit the Target.
Guess the daily mystery NFL player, keep your streak, and share your result — a free daily NFL trivia game.

Place every suspect on a floor plan, one per row and one per column. Whoever is left alone with the victim did it. No guessing necessary — every case has exactly one solution reachable by pure deduction.
Race today's swervle. 3D car racing game, where everyone gets the same map every day.
A daily food guessing game: guess a dish's country of origin from clues about its ingredients and cooking. Includes a food Connections mode and a Higher or Lower mode.
A time-perception game. Guess how long a hidden timer ran, stop it dead on target, echo an interval, hold a beat after it goes silent. Five new rounds every day with practice mode.

A daily word game that rewards creativity. Each day brings five pairs like "Things in a purse *THAT* will confuse the aliens": name something that fits both, say why, and the more clever the idea the higher it scores.

Daily Premier League football trivia game that tests real player statistics rather than club affiliations. Each day, complete a 3×3 grid by naming footballers who satisfy intersecting statistical criteria such as goals scored, clean sheets, appearances, minutes played, or seasons at a club. Answers are scored by rarity.
Daily NFL-player puzzle where you connect a Start player to a Finish player through a chain of shared teams and colleges.
A daily color-matching game built around famous paintings. Each day features a different artwork. Guess the featured color using HSL sliders in 5 tries.
Name the footballer from where he touched the ball. Six guesses, and a clue after every miss.
Everything is connected: Arrange the pictures in a circle so that all links make sense. You have five tries to get it right.
Each day, guess how the world responds to one controversial question. Cast your vote, then predict what percent of the world agrees with you.
Guess the every-day object with a riddle to start with. You get 2 more hints along the way. Each guess reveals a wordle-like grid of object attributes. You have 6 guesses.
A new tier list every day. Place items into tiers, and debate with friends! See how close you were to the rest of your world by viewing the results the next day!
A daily weighing game: one thing sits on a balance scale and you guess how many of something else it takes to balance it, like how many honeybees weigh as much as a horse.
A new sea every day with a daily board. Tilt your phone or move the mouse. A tiny steamboat rides the wave through anchors and mines.
Time estimation game with no clock. You are asked for an interval - 4.3 seconds, say. You press and hold, and the screen goes dark. Let go when you think the time is up.

Daily sports photo game. Every day everyone gets the same three real photos, from 1890s baseball to last season. For each one, drop a pin on the stadium, slide to the year, and name the player or team, all against a 90-second shot clock. Covers basketball, football, baseball, soccer, tennis, boxing, hockey and more, across college, pro and international sports.

Guess how many views a real YouTube video got from its thumbnail. Daily puzzle with 3 guesses (title and channel unlock as clues), plus a higher/lower streak mode and a 5-round Binge mode with shareable challenge links.
TypeCircuit is a daily typing game. Type as fast and accurately as possible to complete the circuit and aim for the highest WPM (Words Per Minute) score.
Daily football trivia game where the obvious answer is the worst answer. Your mission is to name players who fit the prompt but who nobody else will think of.
A daily puzzle. Four charts have lost their axis labels. Put them back in four tries.
Viral Video Guesser Game. Guess which video is more popular! How long of a streak can you get?
Vroomdle is a free daily car guessing game inspired by Wordle. Every day a new mystery car is chosen from a database of 499+ models.
Solve the daily stock ticker with real charts, financial metrics, and guided hints across SPY, Tech, NASDAQ, WallStreetBets, and more.

WasThatBefore is a free daily timeline puzzle where you're given 5 historical events and have to put them in the correct chronological order. Global puzzles, country-specific, and even some state-specific.

A daily football draft game spanning 80 years of World Cups, where Pelé, Maradona and Mbappé can line up on the same XI. Everyone drafts from the same seeded squads each day, then battles through the group stage and knockouts to win!
You are a traveler arrived at Ravenswood Bluff. It's people are slain. Use your deduction skills to find out who the townsfolk truly were.
Guess when a real event happened by placing it on a timeline.
Daily trivia game to guess when and where an event took place
Guess the hidden footballer in this football wordle game. Each guess reveals attributes about the player.
A real price and the people paid out of it. Split it, then see the real figures.
Daily college football game. A future star sat on the bench. Name the QB who started over him.
Guess the footballer behind a blurred photo. The picture sharpens with every wrong guess, and hints on league, nation, position, age and team unlock as you go.
Can you identify the famous person from their attributes?
WhoHadMore is a daily higher/lower game with unique topic every day. Compete to earn your spot on the daily leaderboard by completing the game with as few errors as possible.

A free daily Wordle-like game where players guess the hidden player using clues like club, league, nation, position, age, height, number, etc. Choose between football (soccer), basketball, and NFL modes.

Each day a random year between 1950 and 2025 is chosen. You are given 4 clues from different categories — world events, pop culture, politics, and more — ordered vaguest to most specific. Can you guess the year?
Daily "Guess the Year" History Game. Given a historical fact, guess the year it happened. Depending on how close your guess is, the tile will light up with a different color.
Two real events and one in between. Slide it to where it falls, then see the years.

Four daily history games: name the face or artifact behind a torn portrait in as few tears as possible, guess the historical figure from when and where they were born and died, and sort 16 tiles into four hidden groups.
A real moment from history and three choices. Make your call, then see what the leader actually did. One moment a day.
